d:
Pita hamare lie nakhun ki tarah the
Munh men chabane jaisi buri aadat jaise
Bat-bat men kate jane layaq jitna zaruri
Pyas lagne par pani jitna zaruri nahin
Man jharte balon ki tarah qimti thi
Kamzor aankhon ke lie chashme jitni
Dame ki bimari men lanbi sans jitni
Guzarte dinon ke sath ghati nahin qimat
